name: GMX Exact Matched Character Count Step
overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `ExactMatchedCharacterCount` category — the character count for text units matched unambiguously with a prior translation and thus requiring no translator input. It reads the `AltTranslationsAnnotation` left by a leveraging step and counts a target segment or text container only when its top match is of type `EXACT_UNIQUE_ID` or `EXACT_PREVIOUS_VERSION`, counting characters in the corresponding source. Characters are counted in canonical form — whitespace and punctuation are excluded (hyphens and apostrophes inside words are kept) — and stored as GMX-V metrics annotations for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the character-count counterpart of the exact-matched word-count step.
processingNotes: Only the top-ranked alternate translation of each segment is examined; it qualifies when its match type is `EXACT_UNIQUE_ID` or `EXACT_PREVIOUS_VERSION`.
Counts are computed over the source content of qualifying units; only translatable text units are counted, and a target must be present.
Character counting excludes whitespace and punctuation per GMX-V, but retains hyphens and apostrophes that occur inside a word.
